{{Quote|Remove the commanders, and the rank-and-file will trash like worm out of dirt. Do so in strength and do so in joy. Onward to victory, my friend.|Ray'en|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Ray'en''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]. While there he asked a fellow Coalition member to eliminate Revanite commanders to reduce the effectiveness of their rank and file soldiers.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Ray'en appears as a Sith Warrior gear vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
